correctness.rationale: A closed-neighborhood characterization proves the equivariant join-plus-two-disks decomposition. The alternating chamber double gives spheres, the shore swap has diagonal and anti-diagonal eigenspaces and hence suspended projective quotient; the surviving whole-shore ball attaches nullhomotopically by connectivity. Full permutations give contractible chambers and the full quotient contracts equivariantly. Finite signed Lefschetz/Burnside computations at k=3,4 corroborate all four Euler characteristics, without being used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Canonical balanced biclique dominance topology exhibits an infinite exact transition across natural symmetry subgroups: torsion-free wedge, suspended projective two-torsion in arbitrarily high degrees, then contractible full quotient. The complete homotopy types and sharp first torsion case are not consequences of a non-equivariant sphere-wedge classification.
